You: The commands to create avirtual env:
To create a virtual environment in Python, you can use the following command:

```
python -m venv myenv
```

Replace `myenv` with the name you want to give your virtual environment.

Once the virtual environment is created, you can activate it on Windows using:

```
myenv\Scripts\activate
```

On macOS/Linux, you can use:

```
source myenv/bin/activate
```

Now you're working within your virtual environment!
